column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Do you think Drakeor is leading us into a trap?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你觉得德雷克尔是在引我们入陷阱吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What did he mean by the 'Ulric of legend'?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “他说‘传说中的乌尔里克’是什么意思？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"How did you {i}actually{/i} get those tattoos?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你{i}究竟{/i}是怎么得到那些纹身的？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What have you and Pro been talking about?\"\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你和普洛都在聊些什么？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Anything notable in the town square?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “城镇广场有什么值得注意的吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Champions of The Rebellion — my family — it is our time to be heard...\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “反抗军的捍卫者们——我的家人——该是我们发声的时候了……”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"We stand here today, as harbingers of justice. Through us, it is time for The Monarchy to speak...\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “今天我们站在这里，作为正义的先驱。透过我们，该是让王权发声的时候了……”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"...and it is time for our enemy to realize that they are wrong. Never again will our homes be seized.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “……该是让我们的敌人意识到他们错了的时候了。我们的家园再也不会被夺走。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} ...and it is time for our enemy to realize that we will stop at {i}nothing{/i} to see them fall.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} ...该是让我们的敌人意识到，为了看到他们倒下，我们将{i}不惜一切{/i}。

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"This journey could have easily compromised us, and forced us to do unspeakable things...\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “这段旅程本可能轻易地让我们妥协，迫使我们做出无法言说的事……”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"...but we can rest easy knowing that we've clung to our values and traditions. We are {i}better{/i} than them.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “……但我们可以安心，因为我们坚守了自己的价值观和传统。我们比他们{i}更优秀{/i}。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"The roads of this journey have been paved with compromise, and change...\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “这段旅程的道路由妥协与改变铺就……”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"...but they have been {i}our{/i} changes. We do not conform to their idea of purity, and perfection.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “……但那是{i}我们{/i}的改变。我们不会迎合他们所谓的纯洁与完美。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"And that is exactly why we will win.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “而这正是我们会获胜的原因。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"We will leave behind a world of freedom. We will embrace everybody who has been wrongfully oppressed.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我们将留下一个自由的世界。我们将拥抱每一个被不公正压迫的人。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Everybody will have a place to call home in our new world. Everybody will live as they please.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “在我们的新世界里，每个人都将有一个可以称为家的地方。每个人都能按自己的意愿生活。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Put simply — we will give hope to those who have found their own was stolen.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “简单来说——我们将给那些希望被夺走的人以希望。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Due to The Triumvirate's rule — that number is far too high. But it ends {i}now{/i}.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “由于三人执政团的统治——这个数字实在太高了。但它{i}现在{/i}就结束了。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"No longer will victims find themselves blinded by revenge.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “受害者再也不会被复仇蒙蔽双眼。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"No longer will servants find themselves lost to a quest for redemption.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “仆从再也不会迷失于寻求救赎的途中。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"We have more power than any group of people who have ever spoken up against The Triumvirate.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我们拥有的力量，超过任何曾公开反抗三人执政团的群体。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Unbreakable like our will — we have vessels containing spirits of The Monarchy.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “如我们的意志般坚不可摧——我们拥有承载王权之灵的容器。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"We no longer fight for ourselves. We fight for a lost civilization. This is why we're unstoppable.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我们不再为自己而战。我们为一个失落的文明而战。这就是我们势不可挡的原因。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"With visions just like my own, we have an army of Seers willing to fight for us.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “拥有与我相同的幻象，我们有一支愿意为我们而战的先知大军。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Able to see the future — and every move the enemy can make — we will be unstoppable.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “能够预见未来——以及敌人的每一步行动——我们将势不可挡。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"But most importantly — we have this.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “但最重要的是——我们拥有这个。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Using this blade, I will create a world just like Salus had always envisioned.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “用这把剑，我将创造一个萨卢斯一直所构想的世界。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} Using this blade, I will secure a future that would make The Monarchy proud.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} 用这把剑，我将确保一个足以让王权骄傲的未来。

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Not everybody will see eye-to-eye with our vision. But that is {i}fine{/i}.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “不是每个人都会认同我们的愿景。但这{i}没关系{/i}。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"We will never force anybody over to our way of thinking. We will never rule through fear.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我们永远不会强迫任何人接受我们的想法。我们永远不会通过恐惧来统治。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"When this is all over, we will live in a united world. We will stand together — strong.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “当这一切结束时，我们将生活在一个统一的世界。我们将团结一致——强大。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Everybody will have a voice, and together we will find harmony. We will find peace.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “每个人都将有发声的机会，我们将共同找到和谐。我们将找到和平。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"For The Rebellion!\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “为了反抗军！”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"For The Monarchy!\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “为了王权！”

column3: {image=icons/579.png} \"I'm so sorry that happened to you. It's all so awful.\"

column4: {image=icons/580.png} “说实话，我说不出话来。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I say we make it all the way to the top, and make history.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我说我们就一路冲到顶峰，创造历史。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I say we try our best, but don't make it all the way to the top.\"

column3: {image=icons/660.png} \"Of course. Can't wait to secure that alliance!\"
column4: {image=icons/660.png} “当然。迫不及待想结成那个联盟！”

column3: {image=icons/583.png} \"Fighting side by side with you? That's a dream come true.\"
column4: {image=icons/583.png} “与你并肩作战？那是梦想成真。”

column3: {image=icons/656.png} \"Yeah. Marching into certain death? Born ready.\"
column4: {image=icons/656.png} “是啊。走向必死之路？天生就准备好了。”

column3: {image=icons/579.png} \"I wish we wouldn't have to resort to violence, Ulric.\"
column4: {image=icons/579.png} “我希望我们不必诉诸暴力，乌尔里克。”

column3: {image=icons/580.png} \"I could go either way. It is what it is.\"

column3: {image=icons/660.png} \"Don't worry Valessa, we'll make things work out.\"
column4: {image=icons/660.png} “别担心，瓦莱莎，我们会让事情顺利的。”

column3: {image=icons/583.png} \"My future is clear, as long as you're by my side.\"
column4: {image=icons/583.png} “只要你在身边，我的未来就很清晰。”

column3: {image=icons/579.png} \"You're right. Everything seems so scary and uncertain.\"
column4: {image=icons/579.png} “你说得对。一切都显得那么可怕和不确定。”

column3: {image=icons/656.png} \"Hey, it could be worse. We could've died in the attack.\"
column4: {image=icons/656.png} “嘿，本来可能更糟。我们本可能在袭击中丧命。”

column3: {image=icons/580.png} \"I can understand what you're going through, Valessa.\"
column4: {image=icons/580.png} “我能理解你正在经历什么，瓦莱莎。”

column3: {image=icons/660.png} \"All we can do is be better people than they were.\"
column4: {image=icons/660.png} “我们所能做的，就是做比他们更好的人。”

column4: {image=icons/656.png} “当然是拿它炫耀。那太棒了。”

column3: {image=icons/580.png} \"I don't know. Let's play it by ear.\"
column4: {image=icons/580.png} “我不知道。我们随机应变吧。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"So you want to be the next Elder?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “所以你想成为下一任长老？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"How far out is Peregrino?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “佩雷格里诺有多远？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"About that argument with Fortaime...\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “关于你和福泰姆的那场争论……”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Why do you think that blade gave me visions?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你觉得那把剑为什么会给我幻象？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What would you do differenly?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你会有什么不同的做法？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"How would you restore our connection?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你会如何恢复我们的联系？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Are you sure Valinorth isn't a lost cause?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你确定瓦利诺斯不是无可救药了吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You're right. It's more trouble than it's worth.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你说得对。它不值得这么多麻烦。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Valessa, we need to unite so we can be strong.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “瓦莱莎，我们需要团结才能强大。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I'm not sure which is better, honestly.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “说实话，我不确定哪个更好。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You're right. We'll find a way, together.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你说得对。我们会一起找到办法。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What if it's not possible, Valessa?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “如果这不可能呢，瓦莱莎？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"So you won't share a drink with me?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “所以你不愿意和我喝一杯？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Yeah, I don't want to drink either.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “是啊，我也不想喝。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Will things be okay between you two?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你们俩之间会没事吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You think you're a better fit for Elder?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你觉得你更适合当长老？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Why do you think Fortaime isn't qualified?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你觉得福泰姆为什么不够格？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Can I order an election to be held instead?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我能下令改为举行选举吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What would you do as the Elder of Valinorth?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “如果你当瓦利诺斯的长老，你会做什么？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What do you think about Zamira?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你觉得扎米拉怎么样？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"How do you feel now that we've left Valinorth?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我们已经离开瓦利诺斯了，你感觉怎么样？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What do you mean by 'do with the people'?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你说‘怎么处置这些人’是什么意思？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You know this would interfere with your hobbies, right?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你知道这会妨碍你的爱好，对吧？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Are you sure you're a better fit than Valessa?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你确定你比瓦莱莎更适合吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Alright, we'll find a way.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “好吧，我们会找到办法的。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Maybe it's a lost cause, Fortaime...\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “也许这是无可救药了，福泰姆……”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I agree. Unity is our best choice.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我同意。团结是我们最好的选择。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I think our independence is more important.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我认为我们的独立更重要。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I'm not sure which one I want.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我不确定我想要哪一个。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You make a good case, Fortaime.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你很有道理，福泰姆。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"But the Scribe-in-Training is very important.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “但见习书记官非常重要。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I don't know who to vouch for...\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我不知道该为谁担保……”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You're right. He seems like a cool guy.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你说得对。他看起来是个不错的家伙。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Do you think he can be trusted?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你觉得他能被信任吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Sure thing. You can count on me!\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “没问题。你可以指望我！”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You're on your own with this one, Fortaime.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “这件事你得靠自己了，福泰姆。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Actually, I'm not sure how I'll respond either...\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “其实，我也不确定我会怎么回应……”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"How do you know Sovy?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你怎么认识索维的？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What can you tell me about it?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “关于它，你能告诉我些什么？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"How did The Rebellion manage to seize it?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “反抗军是怎么设法夺到它的？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"In my vision, Sovy used it on you.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “在我的幻象里，索维用它对付了你。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Do you think we'll win because of it?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你觉得我们会因为它而获胜吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"To be honest, I actually can't even use it.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “说实话，我其实根本用不了它。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What are your thoughts on this weapon?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你对这件武器有什么看法？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"How does it accomplish such a thing?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “它是怎么做到这种事的？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"How long has The Triumvirate had it?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “三人执政团拥有它多久了？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"That sounds impressive. Were you on that mission?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “听起来很厉害。你参与了那次任务吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I would've liked to meet the old leader. I won't let him down.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我本想见见老领袖。我不会让他失望的。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Do you think Damek will do a good job as his replacement?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你觉得达梅克接替他后会干得好吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You went out like a hero. You bought us time to escape.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你像个英雄一样离去。你为我们争取了逃跑的时间。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"His strength seemed incredible. Was it him or the blade...?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “他的力量似乎不可思议。那是他本身，还是那把剑……？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Wait — you mean Sovy can't use the blade?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “等等——你是说索维用不了那把剑？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Damek saw our victory, though. Zamira told me.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “不过达梅克看到了我们的胜利。扎米拉告诉我的。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Aside from visions and blades — how do you feel about this war?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “撇开幻象和剑不谈——你对这场战争有什么感觉？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I'm glad to be on the winning side. This is going to be scary.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我很高兴站在胜利的一方。这会很吓人。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"With enough practice, I'm sure I'll be able to master it.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “只要练习够多，我相信我能掌握它。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Would you like to try using it, Ulric?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你想试着用它吗，乌尔里克？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Do you think maybe somebody else could wield it instead?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你觉得也许可以由别人来挥舞它？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I can't be the only one. I refuse to believe that.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我不可能是唯一的一个。我拒绝相信。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Fate has chosen me. I accept the responsibility.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “命运选择了我。我接受这份责任。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"How did {i}you{/i} come to join it?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “{i}你{/i}是怎么加入它的？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Tell me more about Damek.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “多跟我说说达梅克。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"So The Rebellion is largely made up of occupation victims?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “所以反抗军主要由被占领的受害者组成？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Is The Rebellion large? Do we have the numbers to win?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “反抗军规模大吗？我们有人数取胜吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Tell me about the previous leader.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “跟我说说前任领袖。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I'm glad you ended up choosing the right side.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我很高兴你最终选择了正确的一方。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You killed innocents? That's horrible, Ulric!\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你杀了无辜的人？太可怕了，乌尔里克！”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"In your situation, I would've done the same.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “处在你的境地，我也会这么做。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"He seems like a good man. I'm glad to be serving him.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “他看起来是个好人。我很高兴为他效力。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"That's an interesting attitude to have when you're fighting a war.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “打仗的时候还有这种态度，挺有意思的。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I think he needs to wisen up. You can't act that way when you're a leader.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我觉得他需要清醒一点。身为领袖不能那样行事。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"My family was killed there. I guess I'm not alone.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我的家人就是在那里被杀的。看来我并不孤单。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I understand why it took so long to mount an offensive, now.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “现在我明白为什么这么久才发动攻势了。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Training children to be soldiers? That's not right...\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “把孩子训练成士兵？这不对……”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You have a point. I guess you're right.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你说得有道理。看来你是对的。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I don't think that's justification enough...\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我觉得那还不足以成为理由……”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Then I guess I'm glad we have this blade.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “那我想我很高兴我们拥有这把剑。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You really think that strategy can make up for a small army?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你真的觉得那种策略能弥补兵力不足？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"So it's a losing battle...? Wonderful.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “所以这是一场必败之战……？太好了。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"We can't let his sacrifice go to waste.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我们不能让他的牺牲白费。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Mylus must've been shocked to hear all of this.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “迈勒斯听到这一切一定很震惊。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Buried under the new HQ? That's rather poetic.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “被埋在新总部下面？还挺有诗意的。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Tell me about the spirit idols.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “跟我说说灵像。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Is piracy still bad, even after the occupation?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “即使在占领之后，海盗行为仍然是坏事吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Do you ever sail back home to visit?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你曾经航行回家乡探访吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Valinorth's went dark the night I was born.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “瓦利诺斯的在我出生的那晚熄灭了。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Alarinthia's was destroyed...? How?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “阿拉林西亚的被摧毁了……？怎么会的？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"So nobody knew Mazeo had a bigger idol?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “所以没人知道马泽奥有一个更大的灵像？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Is it possible that there's more idols we don't know about?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “有没有可能还有我们不知道的灵像？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"So The Triumvirate was after something else, then?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “所以三人执政团当时是在追别的东西？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Do you think we could win the pirates to our cause?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你觉得我们能争取海盗加入我们的事业吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Is it going to be safe for me to wander around Mazeo?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我在马泽奥四处走动安全吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What will The Rebellion do about piracy after the war?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “战后反抗军会怎么处理海盗问题？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Why do you hate Alarinthia so much?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你为什么这么恨阿拉林西亚？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I guess that makes sense. Home is where you make it.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我想这说得通。家就在你安身之处。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"At least Alarinthia still exists. Valinorth is doomed.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “至少阿拉林西亚还存在。瓦利诺斯是没救了。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Who was the previous Grand Inquisitor?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “上一任大审判官是谁？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Wait — Sovy has an apprentice?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “等等——索维有学徒？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Does The Triumvirate have any more lackeys?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “三人执政团还有别的走狗吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You seem to know an awful lot about this, Ulric.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你似乎对这知道得非常多，乌尔里克。”
